
{{alias}}( token )
    Tests whether a JSON Pointer reference token is safe.

    Parameters
    ----------
    token: string
        JSON Pointer reference token.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating whether a token is safe.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( 'foo' )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( '0' )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( '-' )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( '__proto__' )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}( 'constructor' )
    false
    > bool = {{alias}}( 'prototype' )
    false

    See Also
    --------
